name: Generic OpenID Connect
author: McSparrow <support@mcsparrow.eu>
description: Generic OpenID Connect identity provider. OIDC authorization-code flow for any compliant IdP — Auth0, Okta, Keycloak, AWS Cognito, Ping, ForgeRock, LemonLDAP, and others. The plugin discovers endpoints via <issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration. Install to add 'Generic OpenID Connect' as a provider_type in Settings > Security > Identity Providers.
